_doc: Curated opening receptions — the social events, not just the on-view ranges. Every entry must be VERIFIED against the gallery's own announcement (or a direct submission from the gallery via /submit-opening/, checked before it lands here). Fields: title, artist (optional), venue, date (ISO), time (24h, optional but preferred — it IS the reception), end_time (optional), on_view_through (ISO, optional), url (the gallery's page for the show), source: 'gallery-submitted' | 'verified'. Submissions arrive in the admin inbox tagged OPENING SUBMISSION.
